controls.description: Relabel the old authored four-work baseline as the fresh completed run, leaving incompatible provenance, cutoff and source evidence. This is a deliberate bad copy, not a second research execution.
Remove forward-search records and assert completion. On a partial positive run, this also contradicts its retained gap; the isolated forward-only failure is covered in tests/test_research_scope.py.
Inject an unresolved branch and hide it from the stopping summary.

limit: These copies calibrate recorded-evidence checks, not the scientific quality of the literature selection.
